description: measures compact UTF-8 JSON size against a byte budget using only bounded caller-supplied values. Call when you need a bounded json size budget result before an agent hands structured data or a batch plan to a downstream tool with a stricter contract. Returns the bounded transformation or validation finding with counts, normalized values, and a versioned result contract for JSON Size Budget as versioned deterministic JSON. Limitation: Processes bounded caller-supplied data in memory only; it performs no file fetch, database write, code execution, or retention.

maximum_bytes.description: Maximum Bytes supplied to JSON Size Budget; used only for this bounded calculation and processed in memory without retention.

value.description: Value supplied to JSON Size Budget; used only for this bounded calculation and processed in memory without retention.

name: util_json_size_budget
